description:
As a mobile build engineer, you need to verify and log key build settings from a pipeline configuration file before a release. The configuration file is located at /home/user/build_pipeline/settings.ini and contains several sections. Your task is to: 1. Parse /home/user/build_pipeline/settings.ini and extract the following values: - The version value from the [Release] section. - The minSdk value from the [Android] section. - The exportSymbols value from the [iOS] section. 2. Write these values to a new log file at /home/user/build_pipeline/build_settings.log. 3. The log file must be in the following format (each on its own line, in this order): 
release_version=
android_min_sdk=
ios_export_symbols=
For example, if the version was 1.2.3, minSdk was 21, and exportSymbols was true, the log file would look like: 
release_version=1.2.3
android_min_sdk=21
ios_export_symbols=true
Make sure your log file contains only these three lines, and do not add any extra whitespace. Check the contents of /home/user/build_pipeline/settings.ini to find the correct values.
truth:
Before the task begins, there must be a file at /home/user/build_pipeline/settings.ini with the following contents:
[Release]
version=1.2.3
timestamp=2024-06-15

[Android]
minSdk=21
targetSdk=33

[iOS]
exportSymbols=true
archs=arm64

After task execution, /home/user/build_pipeline/build_settings.log must exist with this exact content (no extra whitespace):

release_version=1.2.3
android_min_sdk=21
ios_export_symbols=true
name: task_000000_f9ab35fc
